hypotheses.P0_exact_recomposition: All-head state recomposition error remains at most 1e-3.
hypotheses.P1_frozen_weight_motifs_are_enriched: The broad causal-program heads are enriched either for membership in the previously frozen bus-robust motif graph or for cross-program component co-membership at one-sided matched-null p <= 0.05; both tests are reported.
hypotheses.P2_static_weight_scale_predicts_programs: Static random-function head scale produces held-out top-three programs above the median subset in at least four material families and mean subset percentile at least 0.65.
hypotheses.P3_input_conditioned_state_scale_predict: Discovery-pair head-write-delta norm produces held-out fidelity at least 0.80 and subset percentile at least 0.80 in at least four material families.
hypotheses.P4_label_blind_output_scale_predicts_pro: Discovery-pair full-vocabulary logit RMS produces held-out fidelity at least 0.80 and subset percentile at least 0.80 in at least four material families.
hypotheses.P5_output_scale_improves_on_state_scale: Mean held-out energy fidelity of the label-blind full-vocabulary predictor exceeds the state-norm predictor by at least 0.05.
hypotheses.P6_semantic_selection_adds_information: The discovery semantic-causal top-three program exceeds the best label-blind predictor by at least 0.05 mean held-out energy fidelity.
